reference.description: Immutable publisher reference supplied independently of OCR outputs; its reviewed conversion policy is preserved in the prepared input bundle.

coverage.qualityCoverage: Full-document headline scores require all pages. Failed and incomplete models have no invented quality score; successful page evidence remains private.

rights.notice: Commons mechanical scans of public-domain originals; Wikisource contributor attribution via pinned page and revision history. Derived text retains share-alike terms.

attribution: Wikisource contributors, page The London Gazette 19345.djvu/2, revision 13200057; Commons scan metadata in input/examples/document/ocr-newspapers/originals/G2.commons.json

evaluation.referenceTextScope: Exhaustive lexical target for the declared input page/crop; drawing syntax is excluded where the publisher serialization declares it.
evaluation.structureAccuracyUnavailableReason: Text-only OCR does not establish column/region localization or page layout. An article crop does not establish whole-page reading order.
evaluation.lexicalMetricLimitation: Headline WER/CER use the existing case-insensitive lexical normalization and declared reference order. Reading-order or serialization differences can increase edit distance; these scores do not measure layout or exact glyph/punctuation fidelity.
evaluation.fidelityMetricLimitation: Literal numeric, punctuation and whitespace comparisons are representation-fidelity diagnostics. TSV tabs, span-continuation blanks, Markdown wrappers and source case conventions can differ without establishing a recognition error.

serializationPolicy.sourceText: Immutable original gold retained; deterministic conversion and separately recorded review errata only.
serializationPolicy.typography: Source small-cap templates become uppercase; long-s and ﬁ retained in main text. NFKC, quote/dash folding and whitespace normalization occur only in companion reference.
serializationPolicy.pageFurniture: Publication header, page number, marginal line/stanza numbers and catchword included. Explicit acquisition crop removes out-of-publication margins.
serializationPolicy.readingOrder: Whole-page logical column order; region crops do not establish full-page ordering. XML drop capitals attach to the next paragraph.
serializationPolicy.lineBreaks: Validated Wikisource logical lines/paragraphs retained; NCSE published physical lines and hyphens retained. Treat layout whitespace independently from lexical fidelity.
